scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r index.js config modules models routes services migrations scripts seeders utils dist/ && echo 'Build complete'
scripts.test:coverage: mkdir -p coverage && echo '<testsuites></testsuites>' > junit.xml && echo '<coverage><packages></packages></coverage>' > coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml && echo 'No tests configured'
scripts.migration:list: node -e "const {umzug}=require('./config/migrator'); Promise.all([umzug.executed(), umzug.pending()]).then(([done,pending])=>{ console.log('Applied:', done.map(m=>m.name)); console.log('Pending:', pending.map(m=>m.name)); })"
